news.contents: Minnesota Vikings running back Jordan Mason rushed eight times for 20 yards in his team's 19-15 loss to the Detroit Lions. Mason couldn't get anything going in Week 8 against one of the league's better run defenses. For what it's worth, backfield mate Aaron Jones Sr. didn't find much room to work either, but he was still far more effective than Mason with his touches and commanded the duo's only two targets in the receiving game. It was an uncharacteristic outing for Minnesota, as their ...
news.title: Jordan Mason Struggles to Make an Impact Vs. Lions

news.analysis: Watson's performance was impressive enough without considering that he reportedly broke a rib, went to the hospital, and still returned before the end of the game. Adding all that into the equation, this was nothing short of a Herculean effort. Watson led the Pack in receptions and yards, recording a new season-high in the former column. The fifth-year pro is finally putting together the type of breakout campaign many have been waiting for, and he'll have a couple extra days to try to heal up before Week 9's game in New England.
news.contents: Christian Watson hauled in 8-of-10 targets for 113 yards in Thursday night's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.title: Christian Watson deals with rib injury, eclipses 100 yards in Week 8

news.contents: Chicago Bears wide receiver Rome Odunze remains a volatile WR3 for Monday's road bout with the reigning Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks.
